Definition: Avvim (as inhabited by Avvites), a place in Palestine (with the article prefix)
BiblicalUsage: Avim = "ruins"; n pr m; 1) a people among the early inhabitants of Palestine located in the southwest corner of the seacoast; n pr loc; 2) a city in Benjamin
